title: Beforest - Forest Investment Reimagined
description: Pitch deck for Beforest, a forest investment company that makes sustainable forestry accessible to everyone.

slides.title: Welcome to Beforest
slides.content: Welcome to Beforest, where we're reimagining forest investment for the modern investor.
slides.notes: Start with energy. Welcome everyone. Emphasize the accessibility angle. Pause after the opening framing.

slides.title: The Problem
slides.content: Traditional forestry investment is opaque, inaccessible, and typically reserved for people with very large capital.
slides.notes: Use the pain points from the original deck: large minimums, poor transparency, long lock-ins, and limited access.

slides.title: Our Solution
slides.content: Beforest democratizes participation through smaller entry points, transparent tracking, and professional forest management.
slides.notes: Contrast with the previous slide. Keep the explanation grounded in the actual solution points from the deck.

slides.title: The Opportunity
slides.content: Forests sit at the intersection of ESG demand, real assets, carbon markets, and long-term stewardship.
slides.notes: Present the opportunity carefully. Do not overstate financial certainty. Stay close to approved deck wording.

slides.title: Join Us
slides.content: Visit beforest.co, explore the opportunity, and continue the conversation if this aligns with your investment thesis.
slides.notes: Clear call to action. Mention the approved website and email. Avoid inventing unsupported urgency.
